entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: We are introducing a new regimen to[n]your rehabilitation in the form of[n][clr 2]Challenge Battles[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: For these trials, we will permit the[n]cognitions of your comrades to fight[n]at your side.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Hmph, cry your tears of joy!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Depending on your results in combat,[n]you will receive some form of[n]compensation for your efforts.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Should you prove successful, there is[n]no doubt that you will be rewarded[n]and strengthened in body and mind.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: We've even prepared a special stage[n]for you to undergo this part of your[n]rehabilitation.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Take this opportunity to demonstrate[n]the furthest reaches of the strength[n]you've gained up to now.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Should you wish to attempt this at once,[n]we shall oblige you.
